clue.text: A relative newcomer's first record takes shape

indicators.note: the first of a word means only its opening letter is used

parts.note: opening letter of newcomer

explanation.surface: A family member who has just arrived is making their first record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A relative newcomer' reads as one phrase, but the definition stops at 'A relative'.
explanation.definitionFit: A nephew is a kinsman, the son of one's brother or sister.

clue.text: Rex fills in French street artist

clue.text: Encourage Teheran for a change

parts.note: old spelling of the Iranian capital, used as written

clue.text: Shy when in the company of Haggard

parts.note: with means in the company of

explanation.walkthrough: Look and say is a reading method, which hides that the two words are simply verbs.
explanation.definitionFit: Proverbs is a book of the Old Testament, a collection of wise sayings.

clue.text: Some cheap oil in a dish

explanation.definitionFit: Poi is a Polynesian food made from fermented taro paste, so it is a dish.

clue.text: Refuse to be unfriendly to Capone

clue.text: Energy needed by Lear excitedly holding court in this play

clue.text: A table leg spattered with trifle

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

clue.text: He pinches the knife as arranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

clue.text: Rubbish collector lacking doctor's sharpness of mind

explanation.definitionFit: Edge is keenness or incisiveness, as in having a competitive edge.

clue.text: Let it stand to harden over time

explanation.definitionFit: Stet is the proofreader's instruction meaning the original wording should remain.

clue.text: Remain unchanged at home with ailment brought about by drink

clue.text: Time not available to check Democrat's plan of things to be done

clue.text: A student of Mark admitting endless depression

clue.text: Dismissed going on TV for a start

a TV set

taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Bacon is cured pork, a familiar breakfast food.
